newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev eases to 201.80/202 per dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev eases to 201.80/202 per dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 201.80-202.00 per dollar, in a narrower spread than 201.60-202.40 morning levels and some 0.70 levs weaker than Monday's close in the interbank market, dealers said.
"A rise in foreign currency demand from a final client in the morning combined with market expectations a further lev's drop and pressured the lev to 202," a bank dealer said.
The lev closed at 201.10/30 to the dollar on Monday
Dollar demand partly eased in the afternoon and spreads narrowed, which helped the lev to consolidate at 201.80/202 until the close in very thin trade, dealers said.
